SCE.S:1AC854: Works at my office. Mother from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:1AC920: My school friend. Does "space-time" research on his father's money. The government watches it.
SCE.S:1AC9EC: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:1ACAB8: Government agent sent to look into the City. Three agents vanished here before he came.
SCE.S:1ACB84: Stern veteran detective. Motto: "Legwork!" Loves conveyor-belt sushi.
SCE.S:1ACC50: Lives outside the City, researching bio-energy. Crop circles often appear by his house.
SCE.S:1CA1E8: That device you say was underground... I really want to see it! Why don't we go back to the {7}power plant{2}? Take me with you!
SCE.S:1CA344: Is there anything else that might be useful? Let's search the garage! The garage is through the door on the right.
SCE.S:1CA40C: There's definitely something at the {7}power plant{2}! Why don't we go right now? It's a short {7}bus{2} ride from here.
SCE.S:1CA554: Wait a second! You should have something to protect yourself. My hunches are pretty good. Take this!
SCE.S:1CA684: So you went to the {7}power plant{2}. Anything strange? There should be a back door to the {7}plant{2}. Did you try going in that way? I'll come along with you!
SCE.S:1CA800: Let me show you the way to the back door.
SCE.S:1CAA20: That device can measure distortions in the space-time continuum. I'm sure you've experienced it yourself, that strange feeling that time seems to move differently depending on where you are. That right there is a distortion in the spacetime continuum. Go closer! You can hear a dull vibration, right? In a natural state there's no way it would make that sound. A phenomenon beyond ordinary theory is happening in this City now. In other words, the town is starting to turn inside out. That's exactly what it feels like. And the {7}power plant{2} sits at the center of that inversion!
SCE.S:1CAC50: That device can measure distortions in the space-time continuum. Haven't you ever felt that time passes differently depending on the place? And the {7}power plant{2} sits at the center of that inversion! You said you saw a strange device under the {7}power plant{2}. That device is probably the cause!
SCE.S:1CAED0: That device is still showing the disturbance. It doesn't look like everything was settled at the {7}power plant{2}!
SCE.S:1CAFF8: That's the kitchen. The device is in the back room. What, are you hungry or something?
SCE.S:1CB0EC: {5}A low-frequency hum comes from the strange machine.
SCE.S:1CB26C: Look what I found. It's what's left of the {8}plastic explosive{2} I used on a job once. I meant to get rid of it since it's dangerous... Glad I kept it. Let's take it to the {7}power plant{2}. It might come in handy. Okay, let's go. We can take the {7}bus{2} or your {7}car{2}.
SCE.S:1CB43C: Look what I found. It's what's left of the {8}plastic explosive{2} I used on a job once. I meant to get rid of it since it's dangerous... Glad I kept it. That device you saw underground. I think it's extremely dangerous. Let's destroy it with this {8}bomb{2}. Okay, let's go. We can take the {7}bus{2} or your {7}car{2}.
SCE.S:1CB658: It's late today. Come back tomorrow.
SCE.S:1CB784: Hey, hey, don't horse around on the bed!
SCE.S:1CB95C: You still seem... human. As long as you're human, I'll help you with anything!
SCE.S:1CB9F8: Hey, you came! It's been a while! Since high school graduation, so more than twenty years, right? I'm really glad you came. I've just been living here ever since... My legs are bad, so I never feel like going out. I've sunk my father's inheritance into my pet research. ...I built a certain device. I think I mentioned it in the email. Take a look, it's to your left.

SCE.S:1CBDA8: Remember what I picked up under the {7}power plant{2}? It was a {8}weapon{2} that uses electromagnetic waves. Think of it as a microwave on steroids. Anyway, try it out! A powerful {8}weapon{2} will definitely come in handy in the "City" now.
SCE.S:1CBEF0: I want to test this {8}EM wave gun{2} somewhere! If we fire it outdoors, the intense light from the discharge will draw a crowd. How about the {7}seaside warehouses{2}? It hasn't been used in years, and the interior is wide open. That's the place! Let's go now!
SCE.S:1CC0D4: I'm examining the thing we picked up at the {7}power plant{2}. Wait a little longer. I'll contact you as soon as I learn something.
SCE.S:1CC19C: You saw my mail. I made something amazing! A {8}weapon that uses a gravity field{2}! I built it by improving the EM wave gun. Even I don't know exactly how the most important part works, but it works fine. Come here and pick it up!
SCE.S:1CC338: I'm modifying the {8}EM wave gun{2} now. I think I can make something even more amazing. I'll contact you as soon as it's done.
SCE.S:1CC3FC: Looks like you can't carry any more weapons. I had the {8}EM wave gun{2} delivered to the {7}newspaper office{2} earlier. Let's go back to the {7}newspaper office{2}, then head to the {7}seaside warehouses{2}.
SCE.S:1CC4F8: Looks like you can't carry any more weapons now. I'll have this {8}gravity weapon{2} delivered to the {7}newspaper office{2}.
SCE.S:1CDFC4: Hey, thanks for dropping by. I learned a great deal from this series of incidents. I'm going to have to keep pushing my research further and further.
SCE.S:1CE1C4: I'll be honest, the device hasnt been working properly. Detecting the anomaly at the {7}power plant{2} was just sheer coincidence.
SCE.S:1CE49C: Now that peace has returned to the town, shall we take a leisurely drive out to the lake sometime?
SCE.S:1CE6A8: Hey, hey, don't horse around on the bed!
SCE.S:1CFE34: ...So even you have changed in the end. I don't intend to fight you. I can't keep up with this change. I plan to end my life as a human. Now, please leave!
SCE.S:1D006C: Don't touch that device! Please. Get out of here!
